Package frc.lib.NinjasLib.localization

Class NinjasSwervePoseTracker

java.lang.Object
frc.lib.NinjasLib.localization.NinjasPoseTracker<edu.wpi.first.math.kinematics.SwerveModulePosition[]>
frc.lib.NinjasLib.localization.NinjasSwervePoseTracker
public class NinjasSwervePoseTracker extends NinjasPoseTracker<edu.wpi.first.math.kinematics.SwerveModulePosition[]>
A NinjasPoseTracker specialized for swerve drivetrains, backed by a SwerveDriveOdometry. This is the concrete tracker type used by RobotPose (both for the vision-fused estimate and the odometry-only estimate) and is generally the entry point subsystems should use rather than the generic base class directly.

    • updateWithTime

      public edu.wpi.first.math.geometry.Pose2d updateWithTime(double currentTimeSeconds, edu.wpi.first.math.geometry.Rotation2d gyroAngle, edu.wpi.first.math.kinematics.SwerveModulePosition[] wheelPositions)
      Updates the pose estimate with new gyro and swerve module readings. Should be called every loop.
      Overrides:
      updateWithTime in class NinjasPoseTracker<edu.wpi.first.math.kinematics.SwerveModulePosition[]>
      Parameters:
      currentTimeSeconds - Time at which this method was called, in seconds.
      gyroAngle - The current gyro angle.
      wheelPositions - The current distance and rotation measurements of the swerve modules; must have the same length as was passed to the constructor.
      Returns:
      The estimated pose of the robot in meters.
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if wheelPositions.length does not match the number of modules the tracker was constructed with.
